scope_guards: The 37,671 brownfield-land records describe register coverage and are not 37,671 planning permissions.
The 354-provider register aggregation is kept separate from the five-provider experimental boundary layer.
The experimental 2,916-site boundary dataset is incomplete and is not substituted for missing register geometry.
A brownfield register capacity or permission-status field is source-bound and is not current title or construction evidence.
A dataset point, polygon or site plan is not automatically an HMLR title extent.
The 2025-12-19 boundary freshness date is retained and not presented as current national geometry completeness.
API and download capability do not prove an executed candidate query or spatial relation.
No score or promotion is written without exact current planning, title, site and statutory-overlay evidence.
